CROSS-REFERENCE.

SUBJECT: K. Groehl.

On 10.4.39. Groehl forwarded to Otten correspondence passing from Richter, Editions Asra in Paris to Dr. F. Fischer in the Hague.

Original in PF 45807 Otten v.4. 153b. as above. dated 17.4.39.
